detail: The portrait camera and continuous snake anatomy are improved. Independent review still favors Snake Pass. A stronger eye/brow pass and a measured rendering optimization are under test.
latestCaption: Round 4 · rendered from a frozen real public replay frame; current code has further expression and scene fixes

reviews.gap: Now clearly beyond a placeholder. Eye-led expression and integrated brow volumes remain the biggest gap; a 45% eye enlargement and unified skull/jaw pass is ready for capture. Animation remains open.
Floor repetition reduced, distant layers added and world triangles reduced 84.5%. Stronger character emphasis and smoother rendering remain open.
The real portrait capture now shows the board clearly along its long axis. Operator toolbar overlap was found and corrected. Code review findings are closed; full browser validation is pending.

rounds.title: Baseline · flat 2D broadcast
rounds.summary: Recorded the existing running game before the 3D transformation.

rounds.title: First construction · verdant ruins
rounds.summary: Original procedural serpent and rich environment, responsive broadcast shell, safe WebGL fallback and motion handling. Visual review is still open.

rounds.title: Round 2 · scene cleanup and performance
rounds.summary: Quiet weathered stone, deeper background, more visible fruit, correct occupancy and public-friendly intent. Capture exposed a shadow-map quality-switch bug; fixed and tested in the next round.

rounds.title: Round 3 · direct character comparison
rounds.summary: Shadow-map rendering is valid after resizing (GL error 0). Blind A/B reference won; character anatomy and close framing are being rebuilt. Portrait distance fog still needed correction.

rounds.title: Round 4 · continuous skull and portrait framing
rounds.summary: A frozen real public replay frame makes the character and camera evidence reproducible. The reference still wins facial expression. Static world merging improved measured throughput from2.29 to3.88FPS without removing scenery; the performance gate remains open.

checks: Deterministic host checks pass 5/5, including restart, recovery, privacy and authority isolation.
12 focused presentation and model checks pass: portal motion, restart, numeric safety, copy, camera fit, fallback visibility, timing and bounded model resources.
Independent code review's three P2 findings are closed after fix re-review and reproduction checks.
Original sandbox-dependent Eko and candidate failures were reproduced as environment restrictions; their escalated focused runs pass 2/2 and 3/3.
Software-rendered cadence remains below the existing 17fps gate. A single-browser profile is separating scene, character and shader cost; no hardware-performance claim is made.
The commercial visual benchmark and external production R5 gates remain open.
